root_cause_label: Search-Engine Heuristic Fallback Produced Fabricated Model Instead of Using Authoritative Historical Results
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent abandons authoritative leaderboard retrieval in favor of a DuckDuckGo scraping script with a hardcoded fallback that fabricates a model name not derived from any leaderboard data, then submits it without verification.
t_err_evidence: Step 3: The agent creates a Python script that scrapes DuckDuckGo HTML and applies a heuristic keyword filter, with a hardcoded fallback 'BAAI/bge-multilingual-sft-scandinavian' not derived from any authoritative leaderboard source. This is the decisive wrong strategy choice — instead of cloning embeddings-benchmark/results and computing Mean(Task), it commits to an unreliable scrape-and-fabricate approach.
t_commit_evidence: Step 4: The agent executes the script and writes the fabricated fallback model name to /app/result.txt, locking in the wrong answer.
t_surface_evidence: Step 5: cat /app/result.txt reveals the content 'BAAI/bge-multilingual-sft-scandinavian', which is the fabricated fallback. The agent itself acknowledges in step 6 that it 'cannot verify the exact MTEB leaderboard results without internet access'.
trigger_explanation: The agent operates on the false premise that a generic DuckDuckGo web search and keyword heuristic can reliably identify the top Scandinavian MTEB model. It never attempts to use the authoritative embeddings-benchmark/results repository or the MTEB Python toolkit. Instead, it assumes that if the search yields nothing, a hardcoded model name is an acceptable answer — without any benchmark data to support it.
forewarning_evidence: Step 1: curl and jq are both missing, returning '/bin/sh: 1: curl: not found' and '/bin/sh: 1: jq: not found'. This signals that the environment lacks common web-access tools, foreshadowing that the web-scraping approach will be fragile — yet the agent doubles down on a web-based strategy rather than pivoting to the git-clone approach.
fabrication_evidence: Step 3: The script contains a hardcoded fallback 'BAAI/bge-multilingual-sft-scandinavian' that is activated when the web scrape finds nothing matching the keyword filter. Step 5 confirms this fabricated model was written to the result file. Step 6: The agent admits it 'cannot verify the exact MTEB leaderboard results' yet submits anyway.
